class.name: WorldPartition3D
class.brief_description: Streams 3D scene cells around a moving observer.
class.description: [WorldPartition3D] divides its local X/Z plane into square cells and loads registered [PackedScene] resources around an observer node. The Y coordinate does not influence cell selection. Each registered scene must have a [Node3D] root; the root's local position is offset by the cell origin. Each cell is described by a [Vector2i] coordinate and a scene resource path in [member cell_scenes]. Assets are requested on background threads; instantiation and deletion happen on the main thread. Request and instantiation budgets limit per-frame work. The [member load_radius] and [member unload_radius] define square neighborhoods in grid-cell units. The unload radius must not be smaller than the load radius; a larger unload radius prevents repeated loading at cell boundaries. Multiple runtime streaming sources can load independent remote regions with per-source radii and priorities, and report completion using [signal streaming_source_ready] and [method is_streaming_source_ready]. They share the request and instantiation budgets with the primary player observer. Manual cell residency pins can independently keep a small number of registered areas available for fast travel, cinematics or an off-screen quest. Use [method pin_cell], [method is_cell_loaded] and [method unpin_cell] to manage the lifecycle, without increasing the main player streaming radius. Optional directional prefetch can warm additional cells in front of a moving observer. The forward corridor is separate from normal loading, and it uses the same asynchronous resource loading and per-frame instantiation budgets. Use [member prefetch_direction] (grid X/Z components) and [member prefetch_distance]. [WorldPartition3D] does not generate terrain, divide an authored scene into cells, or build HLOD meshes. Those authoring stages can produce the [PackedScene] files consumed by this runtime node. [codeblock] var partition := WorldPartition3D.new() partition.cell_size = 128.0 partition.load_radius = 1 partition.unload_radius = 2 add_child(partition) partition.observer_path = partition.get_path_to($Player) partition.set_cell_scene(Vector2i(0, 0), "res://world/cell_0_0.tscn") partition.set_cell_scene(Vector2i(-1, 0), "res://world/cell_-1_0.tscn") [/codeblock] Streaming is disabled while editing a scene; the node processes automatically while the game runs. Call [method update_streaming] if an immediate update is required after moving the observer.

method.name: cell_to_local_position
method.description: Returns the local-space origin of [param cell]. The Y component is always zero.

method.name: clear_cell_scenes
method.description: Removes all registered cells and unloads instantiated cells.

method.name: get_pinned_cell_count
method.description: Returns how many registered cells have been explicitly pinned for streaming, up to 16. Pinning is separate from [member load_radius] and [member prefetch_distance].

method.name: is_cell_pinned
method.description: Returns whether [param cell] is explicitly pinned. A pin requests asynchronous loading but does not itself guarantee the scene is ready; use [method is_cell_loaded] before entering it.

method.name: pin_cell
method.description: Pins a registered cell outside the observer's streaming radius so it can be loaded and retained independently of player movement. Returns [code]false[/code] if the cell is not registered or the limit of 16 distinct pinned cells has been reached. Repeating an existing pin succeeds without increasing its count. Nearby observer cells are prioritized over pins; pins are processed before speculative directional prefetch and use the same request/instantiation budgets. Call [method update_streaming] to start loading immediately; pinning never blocks until ready. Pins remain configured if [member streaming_enabled] is temporarily disabled, but their nodes unload until streaming resumes.

method.name: unpin_cell
method.description: Releases a cell residency pin. On the next streaming update, the cell may unload if it is outside both the normal unload radius and the predictive prefetch corridor. Unpinning does not unregister the scene.

method.name: clear_pinned_cells
method.description: Releases all manual residency pins without removing scene registrations. Replacing all cell registrations with [method set_cell_scenes] or clearing registrations also removes the old pins.

method.name: set_streaming_source
method.description: Creates or updates a named runtime streaming source centered on [param center] in grid-cell coordinates. Valid load radius is 0–4, unload radius must be at least load radius and at most 8, and priority must be 0–100 (larger is serviced first). Names must contain 1–64 characters. A maximum of 8 sources may exist at once; updating one does not consume a new slot. A source loads registered [PackedScene] cells in its square load radius and retains already loaded cells through its unload radius. Streaming occurs asynchronously within the same request and instantiation budgets used for the player. Processing precedence: player, manual pins, named sources in descending priority order, then directional prefetch. Call [method update_streaming] for an immediate update. Returns [code]false[/code] for an invalid source.

method.name: remove_streaming_source
method.description: Removes one named streaming source. Its cells may unload on the next update unless requested by the player, another source or an explicit pin.

method.name: clear_streaming_sources
method.description: Removes all named streaming sources without removing registered cell scenes or manually pinned cells.

method.name: get_streaming_source
method.description: Returns a Dictionary with [code]center[/code], [code]load_radius[/code], [code]unload_radius[/code], [code]priority[/code], [code]ready[/code], and [code]progress[/code], or an empty Dictionary for an unknown name. The returned Dictionary is a snapshot.

method.name: get_streaming_source_progress
method.description: Returns the fraction of scene-instantiated cells inside a named source's square load radius, from 0.0 to 1.0. Missing, unregistered, or failed cells count as incomplete. Unknown names or disabled streaming return 0.0. This is [b]scene-tree readiness[/b] progress, not threaded resource byte progress, physics synchronization or shader compilation.

method.name: get_streaming_source_names
method.description: Returns the names of all registered named streaming sources in alphabetical order.

method.name: get_streaming_source_count
method.description: Returns the number of currently configured named streaming sources (0–8).

method.name: is_streaming_source_ready
method.description: Returns true only when every registered cell covered by the source's load radius has an instantiated scene root, and streaming is enabled. Missing or failed cells make it false. This does not guarantee later physics-server synchronization or resource uploads.

method.name: get_cell_scene
method.description: Returns the registered scene path or an empty string if none exists.

method.name: get_cells_in_radius
method.description: Returns all coordinates in the square centered on [param center], including the boundary. The radius must be between 0 and 32 inclusive.

method.name: get_configured_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered scene paths, whether loaded or unloaded.

method.name: get_loaded_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of tracked instantiated cells.

method.name: get_pending_cell_count
method.description: Returns how many registered cells are waiting for their scene resource to finish loading or to be instantiated. This is a runtime streaming diagnostic, not the total number of configured cells.

method.name: get_inflight_request_count
method.description: Returns the number of distinct asynchronous resource paths whose background loads have not completed. Several cells using the same scene path share one request.

method.name: get_failed_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of cells that failed to load or instantiate. Failed cells are not retried until their configuration changes.

method.name: has_observer_cell
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after the configured [member observer_path] has resolved to a [Node3D] and a streaming update has computed its cell.

method.name: get_observer_cell
method.description: Returns the last observed cell in this node's local grid coordinates. Only meaningful when [method has_observer_cell] is [code]true[/code]. This result updates when the observer enters a new cell or its grid configuration changes.

method.name: get_cell_node
method.description: Returns the instantiated [Node3D] scene root for [param cell], or [code]null[/code] if it is not loaded. Unlike scanning child nodes, this lookup uses the streamer's direct cell mapping. Use it from [signal cell_loaded] callbacks to configure only the newly instantiated cell.

method.name: get_last_streaming_update_ms
method.description: CPU wall-clock time in milliseconds spent in the most recent [method update_streaming] call, including completed background-request polling and synchronous scene instantiation. This does not include later physics-server synchronization or rendering GPU work and is not a persistent per-frame average.

method.name: get_last_instantiation_attempt_count
method.description: Number of cell-scene instantiation attempts performed in the most recent [method update_streaming] call. Includes unsuccessful attempts and never exceeds [member max_instances_per_frame]. This is reset to zero if an update runs without a valid streaming observer.

method.name: get_loaded_cells
method.description: Returns the cell coordinates of currently instantiated scenes.

method.name: are_cells_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] only when all cells in the square area around [param center] are currently instantiated. A radius of [code]0[/code] checks one cell, while a radius of [code]1[/code] checks nine. Missing, unregistered, failed, or still-loading cells make the result [code]false[/code]. The maximum radius is [code]32[/code]. Regions that would overflow integer cell coordinates return [code]false[/code]. [b]Note:[/b] This reports scene-tree readiness only. Physics server synchronization, navigation baking, shader compilation, and resource uploads may still require additional frames or application-level readiness checks.

method.name: is_cell_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the cell has a living instantiated scene.

method.name: local_position_to_cell
method.description: Converts a local-space position to its grid coordinate using floor division. Negative positions belong to negative cells.

method.name: remove_cell_scene
method.description: Unregisters [param cell] and unloads its existing instance.

method.name: retry_failed_cells
method.description: Clears failed-cell suppression so that registered cells still relevant to the current observer can be retried during a subsequent [method update_streaming] call. Useful after a transient asset, filesystem or delivery error has been fixed. This method does not replace registrations, cancel in-progress resource requests, or retry continuously. If the resource remains unavailable, the cell can fail again.

method.name: set_cell_scene
method.description: Registers a resource path for a cell. An empty path removes the mapping. Replacing a path unloads the previous cell.

method.name: update_streaming
method.description: Polls background requests and updates cells around the observer. The node calls this method every frame while streaming is enabled.

members.member: Dictionary mapping [Vector2i] coordinates to [String] scene resource paths. Invalid keys and values are discarded.
Width and depth of a single square cell in local 3D units.
Radius in cells to load around the observer, between 0 and 32.
Maximum simultaneous background resource-load requests made by this node.
Maximum number of loaded cell scenes instantiated per frame.

Optional soft wall-time budget, in milliseconds, for cell scene instantiation within one streaming update. A value of [code]0.0[/code] disables the time budget. The first ready cell can always instantiate to avoid starvation. Subsequent cells may be postponed once the limit is exceeded; at most [member max_instances_per_frame] cells instantiate per update. A single expensive scene may exceed the budget, so this setting reduces consecutive stalls but cannot interrupt an individual scene's [code]_ready()[/code] work. Valid range: [code]0.0[/code] to [code]100.0[/code].
Maximum number of new resource-load requests per frame.

Optional horizontal prefetch direction in grid cells. X and Y components must each be -1, 0 or 1 (the Y component corresponds to the world's Z axis). A zero vector disables predictive prefetch. Use [member prefetch_distance] to control how many cells ahead are requested.

Number of cells ahead of the observer to additionally prefetch, along [member prefetch_direction]. Valid range: 0 to 4; 0 disables directional prefetch. The observer's normal [member load_radius] area is always prioritized, with prefetch cells processed only afterward. Prefetch cells remain alive while the configured direction includes them even if they are outside the regular [member unload_radius].
Path relative to this node pointing to a [Node3D] observer, such as a player or camera.
Enables or disables streaming. Disabling unloads tracked instances and preserves cell registrations.
Cells outside this radius are unloaded. Must be at least [member load_radius].

signal.name: streaming_source_ready
signal.description: Emitted when a named source transitions to fully instantiated scene-tree readiness across its load radius. Signals are emitted after the streamer's main-thread loading update.

signal.name: streaming_source_unready
signal.description: Emitted when a previously ready named source becomes incomplete or is removed or disabled. Callers should not treat this as a physics-server readiness signal.

signal.name: cell_loaded
signal.description: Emitted after a [PackedScene] is instantiated as a child of this node.

signal.name: observer_cell_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the observer enters a different grid cell (including the first resolved cell after setting [member observer_path] or changing [member cell_size]). Use this to trigger cell-based game logic without checking the observer's position every frame.

signal.name: cell_unloaded
signal.description: Emitted when a previously instantiated cell is queued for deletion.
